item.title: [PROJ-123] Implement user authentication system
item.description:
As a system administrator, I want to implement a secure user authentication system so that users can safely access the application with proper credentials.
Acceptance Criteria: 1. Users should be able to register with email and password 2. Users should be able to login with their credentials 3. Password should be encrypted and stored securely 4. Session management should be implemented 5. Failed login attempts should be logged 6. Password reset functionality should be available
Technical Requirements: - Use JWT tokens for session management - Implement rate limiting for login attempts - Use bcrypt for password hashing - Add two-factor authentication support
